dossier.headline: Blackstone takes about 16% of IIFL Finance in ₹6,414 crore raise
dossier.summary: IIFL Finance's board approved a ₹6,414 crore preferential raise on November 10, led by ₹5,000 crore from Blackstone funds via convertible preference shares at ₹602, plus ₹1,264 crore from promoters and ₹150 crore from Anchorage Capital. The company says control does not change and capital adequacy should rise from about 17% to 30% pro forma. Shares jumped on Wednesday.
why_it_matters: A large foreign private-equity bet on an Indian non-bank lender
The capital cushion gives the lender room to grow its loan book
